prop:multivariate_dc_lift.scope: The formal helper covers the uniform-coefficient lift P(x-y)+L*sum(y)-c: sufficient convexity, sufficient monotonicity from monotonicity of P and L*sum-P, exact difference, and nonnegative-orthant preservation under c<=P(0). The source proposition additionally allows an arbitrary coefficient vector and states converse convexity/derivative-bound equivalences; those general clauses are not formalized by this leaf. The specialized softmax result is independently proved without these missing general converses.

thm:softmax_dc_split.scope: The literal normalized log-sum-exp plus/minus softmax heads for every finite nonempty index type and every output coordinate: global joint convexity and coordinatewise monotonicity on independent real stream vectors, exact recovery, and nonnegative values on the expanded nonnegative orthant. The normalizer is exactly (log(n)-1/n)/2, with origin values 1/n and 0. Singleton rows are included; empty rows are excluded. Actual softmax derivatives and curvature bounds are proved, not assumed. This is a row primitive, not a complete masked-attention or Transformer compilation theorem.

prop:convex_product_pair.scope: The literal polarized half-sums of squares have exact signed-product difference, globally convex nonnegative heads, and coordinatewise monotonicity on the nonnegative four-stream orthant. Composition with nonnegative convex input streams preserves convexity; composition with nonnegative monotone input streams preserves order. The square identity follows by using the same two input streams twice. No global product-head monotonicity or complete matrix/attention graph compiler is asserted by this primitive.

prop:reciprocal_sqrt_pair.scope: For every epsilon>0, the actual tangent extension and pair r(x-y)+M*x, M*x have globally convex coordinatewise monotone heads, nonnegative values on the input quadrant, and exact inverse-square-root recovery whenever the represented variance x-y is nonnegative. The coefficient is proved equal to 1/(2*epsilon^(3/2)); the joining derivative at zero is checked. This certifies only the scalar reciprocal-square-root normalization primitive, not centering, variance computation, learned scale/bias, or complete LayerNorm/Transformer composition.
